title: Tomato Flatbread
description: A flavorful flatbread topped with fresh tomatoes and spices.
instructions: 2. Roll out flatbread to desired thickness.
3. Spread zesty seasoning evenly across flatbread.
5. Arrange tomato slices on top of flatbread.
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes, or until flatbread is crispy.
7. Remove from oven and let cool for 2 minutes.
8. Cut into bite-sized pieces and serve.
